issue_context.title: ESQL: mv_dedupe does not work with data from an index
issue_context.body:
On current main (bec2115f8ffd2e6efedf3776a733d8c42a98e625), `mv_dedupe`  does not seem to do anything if its argument is an integer field:
```
POST /testidx/_doc
{
  "int_field": [1, 2, 2, 3]
}

POST /_query
{
  "query": "from testidx | eval mv_dedupe(int_field)"
}

   int_field   |mv_dedupe(int_field)
---------------+--------------------
[1, 2, 2, 3]   |[1, 2, 2, 3] 
```

Using a text field instead, all seems fine:
```
POST /testidx/_doc
{
  "text_field": ["a", "b", "b", "c"]
}

POST /_query
{
  "query": "from testidx | eval mv_dedupe(int_field)"
}

   int_field   |  text_field   |text_field.keyword|mv_dedupe(text_field)
---------------+---------------+------------------+---------------------
[1, 2, 2, 3]   |null           |null              |null                 
null           |[a, b, b, c]   |[a, b, c]         |[a, b, c] 
```

Using integers in a `row` expression also works as expected:
```
POST /_query
{
  "query":  "row x = [1,2,2,3]| eval mv_dedupe(x)"
}

       x       | mv_dedupe(x)  
---------------+---------------
[1, 2, 2, 3]   |[1, 2, 3] 
```
comments: Small update: bug is still present on current main.
